title: Continuous 2026 poll layer — verified national poll time series (ROADMAP R4)
method: Every row was transcribed from a source fetched during a verification session (per-row verifiedVia + verifiedOn). No modeled or interpolated values: where a chart row in a fetched article did not publish that wave's sample/MoE, the fields say so. The generic-ballot question wording differs between pollsters and is recorded per row; margins are computed arithmetically from the published D/R figures (labeled 'computed'). New verified releases append to this file; nothing is overwritten silently.
